svg.title: Plasma cell
svg.desc: Oval plasma cell with eccentric clock-face nucleus, broad basophilic cytoplasm, rough ER, and perinuclear Golgi hof. Biological basis: Antibody-secreting plasma cells expand rough endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi; heterochromatin forms the characteristic cartwheel nucleus.
